title: Ashcombe Rising
author: E. M. Whitlock
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
